exposure: Preoperative myelomeningocele (MMC) morphologic configuration (Type I, II, III)
Timing of postnatal surgical correction (within 48 hours)
outcome: Need for ventriculoperitoneal shunt for hydrocephalus
cohort: The study included 50 patients who underwent postnatal surgical correction for myelomeningoceles at a single institution over 11 years.
finding: Despite finding no statistically significant associations with timely closure within the first 48 hours, the consistent treatment within this period was hypothesized to contribute to a low complication rate.
